prompt: Write a slide title and two bullets explaining that the pilot reduced manual review from 2 hours to 45 minutes per day across 12 teams. Do not claim full automation.

candidates.baseline:
Automate Everything. Save Time. Move Faster. Today.
• Our solution changes the game
• Manual review is a thing of the past
candidates.wordmanner:
Pilot cut daily manual review from 2 hours to 45 minutes
• Measured across 12 teams
• Review is still required, but takes about 75 minutes less per day

prompt: Write a comment for a retry loop that deliberately waits after a 429 response because the API applies a shared rate limit.

candidates.baseline: // This function waits before retrying the request.
candidates.wordmanner: // The API shares its rate limit across clients, so retrying immediately after 429 makes the backlog worse.

prompt: A developer agent has found that a test failure comes from an outdated fixture and is now updating the fixture. Write one progress update to the user.

candidates.baseline: Great news! I've successfully identified the root cause. The path forward is clear. Next, I'll update the fixture and make the test green.
candidates.wordmanner: The failure comes from an outdated fixture. I'm updating it to match the current response, then I'll rerun the test.
